invariant_bindings.invariant_text: Challenges MUST be >=16 bytes from a CSPRNG and MUST be single-use; replaying a challenge SHALL reject the response.
The origin in clientDataJSON MUST exactly match the configured RP origin; subdomain or scheme mismatch CANNOT be accepted.
The RP ID hash in authenticatorData MUST equal SHA-256(rp_id); mismatch MUST fail verification.
finish_assertion() MUST reject when the new sign_count is <= the stored sign_count, except when the authenticator always returns 0.
The user-verification flag MUST be enforced for authenticators registered as user-verifying; absence SHALL fail the assertion.
Credential public keys MUST be stored bound to (user_id, credential_id) and SHALL NEVER be shared across users.
